payload.need: Do not import PURE_WEYL_BH3_EXTERIOR_BVP_WELLPOSEDNESS_GATE into Paper 14 as a well-posedness theorem in its current form. The certificate asserts W_E is not identically zero only because the boundary solutions are generically independent, while it explicitly computes no Wronskian value and supplies no independent nonzero witness. Preserve the exact log-tail and conditional Wronskian structure, add contradiction mutations rejecting generic-independence-as-proof and outgoing-label-failure-as-full-ill-posedness, and keep Paper 14 scoped to the already-certified real-frequency finite-flux theorem.
